cases.type: Digital member product / skill-based community matchmaking
cases.core_model: On October 21, 2026 Life Time announced completed integration of Dynamic Universal Pickleball Rating (DUPR) into its app across all clubs offering pickleball. Members can link their rating to club membership, track progress, find level-matched partners and join rating-gated or open-level leagues/play.
cases.target_members: Pickleball members seeking appropriate competition, measurable improvement and more convenient repeat participation.
investment_modules: Member app integration with external sport-rating system
Level-matched class, league and partner discovery
Coach-led skill assessment and community moderation
cases.service_mechanism: Existing Life Time member ID links to DUPR; rating appears alongside court booking tools; clubs can offer rating-gated Open Play as well as non-rated formats, with pros available to guide members.
cases.community_mechanism: Skill-matched leagues and open play reduce coordination friction, help newcomers find compatible peers and give advanced players measurable progression.
cases.why_it_may_work: A verified ability signal can improve matching, fairness and repeat use of existing facilities. Business impact is not yet independently disclosed.
cases.plus5lbs_takeaway: Apply the principle to running/strength: ability and goals -> appropriate coach, training group, challenge or race prep. Pilot simple levels, opt-in profiles and coach validation before investing in custom scoring software.
cases.avoid_copying: Do not build a proprietary rating system without critical mass or sport-specific validity. Avoid excluding beginners and respect consent/privacy for member performance data.
cases.investment_decision: Partner or integrate existing validated ratings; build member journeys and coach matching; pilot level-based groups before custom software.
cases.evidence_status: High for official announced completed rollout and product features (Life Time release 2026-10-21); retention or commercial lift not publicly verified.

cases.city: Beijing and Shanghai, China (historical mainland operations)
cases.type: Historical boutique fitness / music-led immersive classes / prepaid membership caution
cases.core_model: SpaceCycle built a premium class experience around cycling, music, lights, coach personality, studio quality and high-service changing rooms. Jiemian/Focus One reported mainland Beijing/Shanghai operations ceased from May 1, 2024 following liquidation notice, with member prepaid balances disputed. Official brand site is older and must not be read as current store evidence.
cases.target_members: Historically premium urban boutique-class consumers seeking immersive workouts, coach relationships, community and convenience.
investment_modules: Coach identity and recurring member relationships
Transparent prepaid service obligations and member trust
cases.service_mechanism: Historically immersive classes, carefully serviced changing rooms and social waiting spaces. Reports of sudden closure and outstanding prepaid lessons make consumer trust and continuity central negative lessons.
cases.community_mechanism: Strong coach-led communities and social identity were reported by former members; some continued following coaches after closures.
cases.why_it_may_work: Strong atmosphere and personal instructor connection created perceived differentiation, but brand affinity did not prevent operating failure. Membership prepaid revenue cannot be treated as earned service value.
cases.plus5lbs_takeaway: Learn from coach culture, cleaning cadence, showers and between-class social comfort; separately design customer-funds protection, fulfillment obligations, refund transparency and continuity plans.
cases.avoid_copying: Do not copy aggressive prepaid selling, costly experiential build-out or dependence on star instructors without resilient service economics. Do not label mainland Space as currently operating.
cases.investment_decision: Build service quality and coach standards; selectively pilot immersive formats; establish prepaid liability governance; defer heavy sensory build-out.
cases.evidence_status: High for historical brand concept (official archived site); medium-high for 2024 mainland closure and member accounts (Jiemian/Focus One report); current status of any separate Taiwan operations not assessed.

cases.type: Boutique performance club / integrated recovery / running community
cases.core_model: Two Madrid locations under one membership combine coached small-group Strength, HYROX, Sculpt and S&C, Open Gym, sauna/cold/infrared recovery, running club and community events. The official membership page lists Foundation €169/month (8 classes + 4 recovery), Ritual €219/month (unlimited classes + 4 recovery), All In €269/month (unlimited classes + recovery) and Reset €199/month (recovery-focused); these are displayed monthly prices as checked 2026-11-02, not guaranteed ongoing rates.
cases.target_members: Urban training-oriented members, HYROX competitors, runners, and recovery-only customers who may already train elsewhere.
investment_modules: Sauna and cold immersion with safety procedures
Coffee partner and private changing rooms
cases.service_mechanism: Official site offers a €69 7-day trial of 3 classes plus 1 recovery session, credited toward first membership month if joining; recovery-only 3-pack €79. Single membership across two sites, class and recovery booking, guest passes; compression at Justicia only. Website FAQ and membership page differ on legacy tier names, so current live membership page is preferred and should be rechecked.
cases.community_mechanism: Coach-led runs Tuesday and Thursday from Justicia with coffee afterward; HYROX competition trips, workshops and Recovery Social Club with scheduled group sauna/cold sessions. Public site says 500+ community members and 5.0 Google rating; these are brand claims, not independently audited.
cases.why_it_may_work: The entry offer lets prospects experience both training and recovery, while distinct class/recovery allowances create clear reasons to upgrade. Running and recovery rituals create repeat occasions and referrals; retention effect remains unproven.
cases.plus5lbs_takeaway: Pilot a 7-day Training+Recovery intro pass, 2–3 membership tiers defined by service allowances, and a coach-led running club with post-run recovery/social sessions. Measure trial-to-join, recovery utilization, coach capacity, repeat visits, and guest-to-member conversion.
cases.avoid_copying: Do not treat cold exposure or infrared claims as clinical proof; ensure safety and appropriate screening. Do not copy recovery inclusions before capacity and operating cost validation. Do not cite brand self-reported reviews as independent verification.
cases.investment_decision: Build coached training and run-club cadence; pilot limited recovery and membership credits; partner cafe/clinical services; defer advanced recovery technology until validated.
cases.evidence_status: High for currently published facilities, addresses and membership entitlements (official site checked 2026-11-02); medium for independently verified operations, member satisfaction and commercial outcomes.

cases.why_it_may_work: The programme sells continuity and visible progression, creating a training reason to return beyond one-off classes. Actual completion and retention are not publicly disclosed.

cases.avoid_copying: Do not assume a dedicated studio is necessary at launch; start with scheduled floor zones. Do not treat brand-listed recovery services as evidence of medical efficacy.
cases.investment_decision: Build progressive programming and coach standards; pilot cohort classes; defer separate studio until utilization validates it.
cases.evidence_status: High for open club and official Strong programme description (official club page, checked 2026-11-02); medium for 12-week mechanics (HCM report 2026-08-25); retention effects are analytical hypothesis.

research_log.title: Life Time Q3 2026 operator evidence: services and membership value
research_log.summary: Official Oct 29 release: Q3 center revenue $871.127m; in-center revenue $249.026m (28.6% of center revenue), vs 28.1% in Q3 2025. Average quarterly center revenue per center membership $1,016 vs $907 (+12.0%). Company attributes growth partly to improved membership mix and higher utilization of in-center services, particularly Dynamic Personal Training. These are company-level signals, not causal proof for individual services or new LT Social programme. Source: https://ir.lifetime.life/news-events/press-releases/detail/1241/life-time-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results

layers.rule_zh: 只记录可核验的产品、流程、空间、价格或行为。
layers.rule_en: Record only verifiable products, flows, spaces, prices or behaviors.

layers.rule_zh: 拆解课程结构、教练动作、进阶、预约与社群组织。
layers.rule_en: Decompose programming, coaching, progression, booking and community operations.

layers.rule_zh: 提出因果假设，并同时列出支持证据与反证。
layers.rule_en: State causal hypotheses with supporting and counter-evidence.

layers.rule_zh: 跨品牌、跨运动组合，但明确标记为推演。
layers.rule_en: Combine brands and sports while labeling ideas as hypotheses.

layers.rule_zh: 按标准店、PLUS、尊享店、1788待开业旗舰店分别转译。
layers.rule_en: Translate separately for Standard, PLUS, Premium and planned 1788 flagship formats.

evidence_rules_zh: 品牌官方事实不等于经营结果
用户评价可提示问题但不能证明因果
没有实测数据时结论必须标记为假设
每轮必须记录新增、修正或无变化
evidence_rules_en: Official brand claims are not operating outcomes
Member reviews can signal issues but do not prove causality
Conclusions without measured outcomes remain hypotheses
Every run records a delta, correction or explicit no-change

topics.title_zh: 团课产品化：从排课到可进阶的训练产品
topics.title_en: Group Training Productization: From Timetable to Progressive Product
topics.research_question_zh: 什么机制能让团课同时提高训练结果、固定到店节奏、教练关系与会员归属，而不依赖不断增加课量？
topics.research_question_en: Which mechanisms let group training improve outcomes, visit rhythm, coach relationships and belonging without simply adding more classes?

conclusion.zh: 最值得复制的不是更多课程，而是“固定周期 + 明确进阶 + 教练反馈 + 同伴身份 + 跨运动出口”的产品链。第三空间 Strong 提供周期与进阶证据；Revive 展示训练、恢复与跑团仪式的组合；Goldfinger 展示固定训练与身份；Life Time 展示能力分层和社交层。尚无公开证据证明这些机制必然提升续费，因此应通过小规模队列实验验证。
conclusion.en: The transferable pattern is not more classes but a chain of fixed cycles, visible progression, coach feedback, peer identity and cross-sport pathways. Third Space Strong evidences progression; Revive combines training, recovery and run rituals; Goldfinger shows recurring practice and identity; Life Time demonstrates ability matching and a social layer. Public evidence does not prove retention impact, so the model requires a controlled pilot.

what.claim_zh: Third Space Strong 是 12 周渐进式小团体力量产品。
what.claim_en: Third Space Strong is a 12-week progressive small-group strength product.

what.claim_zh: Revive 以训练次数、恢复权益、跑团和社群活动组成分层会员产品。
what.claim_en: Revive tiers training, recovery, run club and community rituals.

what.claim_zh: Goldfinger 以每周固定训练、赛事与会员身份组织跑者。
what.claim_en: Goldfinger organizes runners through recurring sessions, races and membership identity.

how.zh: 用 4–12 周队列代替无终点的散课；首测、周中反馈、结营复测构成闭环。
how.en: Use 4–12 week cohorts instead of endless drop-ins, with baseline, mid-cycle feedback and retest.

how.zh: 教练拥有固定队列，职责从授课扩展到评估、记录、匹配训练伙伴和下一周期建议。
how.en: Give coaches stable cohorts and responsibility for assessment, tracking, peer matching and next-cycle recommendations.

how.zh: 建立 Foundation → Build → Perform 进阶路径，并保留公开体验课作为入口。
how.en: Create a Foundation → Build → Perform progression path with open classes as acquisition.

why.hypothesis_zh: 固定周期可能降低选择成本，并让会员感知进步。
why.hypothesis_en: Fixed cycles may reduce choice friction and make progress visible.
counter: 公开资料未披露完成率或续费提升

why.hypothesis_zh: 固定教练与同伴可能增强承诺和归属。
why.hypothesis_en: Stable coaches and peers may strengthen commitment and belonging.
counter: 社交偏好因人而异，强制分组可能劝退部分会员

why.hypothesis_zh: 训练与跑步、恢复等跨运动出口可增加使用场景。
why.hypothesis_en: Cross-sport pathways into running and recovery may expand use occasions.
counter: 模块过多会增加教练负荷与运营复杂度

what_if.zh: Runner's Strength：店内力量进阶 + 店外跑团 + 回店恢复与复盘。
what_if.en: Runner's Strength: in-club progression, outdoor run club, return-to-club recovery and review.

what_if.zh: Hybrid Club：力量、体能与团队挑战组成 6 周赛季，不直接复制赛事品牌。
what_if.en: Hybrid Club: a six-week strength, conditioning and team challenge season without copying event IP.

what_if.zh: Coach Guild：教练跨店共研课程，每月用一项动作标准和会员反馈修订教案。
what_if.en: Coach Guild: cross-club curriculum review, revising one movement standard and lesson from member feedback monthly.

application.model_zh: 每周 1 个固定社群课 + 4 周 Foundation；利用现有训练区，不新增专用教室。
application.model_en: One weekly ritual plus a four-week Foundation cohort using the existing floor.

application.model_zh: Foundation / Build / Perform 三层路径，增加小团体付费计划与训练记录。
application.model_en: Foundation / Build / Perform pathway with paid small-group programs and progress tracking.

application.model_zh: 签名课程 + 固定教练队列 + 恢复与会员社交延伸，强调服务密度而非课量。
application.model_en: Signature classes, stable coach cohorts, recovery and social extensions; prioritize service depth over volume.

application.model_zh: 开业前用 2 个 6 周创始会员赛季验证；成熟后再设置专用空间与跨运动品牌合作。
application.model_en: Validate with two six-week founding-member seasons before dedicated space or cross-sport partnerships.

counter_evidence_zh: 现有来源多为品牌官方资料，缺少公开的完成率、留存和单位经济数据。
大型专用团课空间未必适合所有店型。
能力分层若标签化或门槛过高，可能损害新手体验。
counter_evidence_en: Most sources are brand-owned and lack completion, retention and unit-economics data.
Dedicated studios may not fit every format.
Ability tiers can harm beginner experience if they become labels or barriers.

open_questions.zh: 4 周与 8–12 周产品，哪种对首次会员更合适？
open_questions.en: Are four-week or 8–12 week programs better for first-time members?

open_questions.zh: 固定教练队列能否提高二访和下一周期转化？
open_questions.en: Do stable coach cohorts improve second visits and next-cycle conversion?

open_questions.zh: 跨运动出口应从跑步、HYROX式体能还是户外开始？
open_questions.en: Should the first cross-sport pathway be running, hybrid conditioning or outdoors?

experiments.title_zh: THE +5 PROGRAM｜4 周团课产品化试点
experiments.audience_zh: 首次参与团课或缺乏稳定训练节奏的会员
experiments.audience_en: Members new to group training or without a stable rhythm
steps_zh: Week 1–3：固定教练、同伴和渐进训练
Week 2：一次 5 分钟个人反馈
Week 4：复测、成果回顾和下一周期建议
steps_en: Weeks 1–3: stable coach, peers and progression
Week 4: retest, review and next-cycle recommendation
experiments.decision_rule_zh: 完成率和下一周期转化均达到门店基线以上，且教练负荷可控，才扩大课次或设置专用空间。
experiments.decision_rule_en: Expand slots or dedicated space only if completion and next-cycle conversion beat baseline without unacceptable coach load.
